name: @olai/git
//exports: Three entries, and only the first is the package. `./state` is the vocabulary WITHOUT the plumbing — RepoState and Reason travel the wire, so @olai/format re-exports them for its pending schema and the browser ends up importing them; the main entry reaches node:child_process, which a browser bundle must never do, so the wire half is reachable on its own. `./testlib` is not product either: a real repository in the states a commit path has to tell apart, published so the packages ABOVE build their fixtures the same way rather than each growing its own `git init` that forgets `user.email` on a CI runner. The same carve-out @olai/format and @olai/log make, for the same reason.
//dependencies: `effect` and `@olai/child`, deliberately: this is a LEAF beside `format` and `log` (docs/architecture.md) whose subprocess socket is the sibling's. A second workspace sibling here would be knowledge about outlines, writers or a wire coming back.
//devDependencies: @types/node is for `node:child_process` and `node:fs`, which this package IS. @olai/log is here for its `./testlib` collector ONLY — a refusal is reported as a log line, so a test of what it reports has to hear one, and hearing one has exactly one spelling in this tree. Deliberately not a runtime dependency: the levels and the verbs are Effect's, so nothing in src/ imports it.
